notes: Official Google remote MCP server at https://developerknowledge.googleapis.com/mcp, backed by the Developer Knowledge API (developerknowledge.googleapis.com). Google Cloud credentials were verified in project mailmind-ai-djbuw under account maassenhochrath@gmail.com. The Developer Knowledge API was initially disabled in that project and was enabled successfully via Google Cloud REST control-plane calls. Authenticated tests then succeeded: REST searchDocumentChunks for Cloud Run (~376 ms), Gemini API (~299 ms), and Firebase Auth (~276 ms); full document retrieval for documents/docs.cloud.google.com/run/docs/monitoring (~465 ms); and bearer-authenticated MCP tools/list against the remote endpoint. Advertised tools are read-only and narrow: search_documents returns chunked matches with parent document handles, and get_documents returns full Markdown documents for supplied names. This is a strong READ-adapter candidate for OBJ07/OBJ22 hydration because it is canonical, structured enough for deterministic ingestion, and constrained to documentation retrieval rather than mutation. Limitations remain: Preview / Pre-GA, corpus limited to public Google documentation only, English-only, and Markdown generated from HTML rather than richer typed entities. The recorded latency is a rounded average of successful authenticated search/get calls, not a load-tested benchmark.
